''See also: [[Chaka Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Chaka is a formidable fighter who possesses [[sword]] blades in place of hands. Though he may initially appear to be a man wearing mismatched leather armor, a The mask{{!}}mask, and a helmet, he is no longer human. He is characterized by his yellow gemstone eyes and an intimidating presence. Chaka often spends time resting in the shade of a fruit tree, where he challenges others to duels to earn their meals. He is an exceptionally skilled combatant who only loses fights when he chooses to do so. His temperament can range from cheery and warm to harsh and threatening, and he has been known to influence others to drive people away. In the past, his presence in a city was said to have transformed its physical landscape and its [[inhabitants]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Chaka is a leather man featuring yellow gemstones in place of his eyes. Instead of hands, he possesses [[sword]] blades for limbs.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A fighter who rests in the shade of a fruit tree, Chaka duels challengers in exchange for meals. He harbors a dislike for Andra Agnos{{!}}Andra and may have played a role in influencing [[Nye]] to drive her away.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Chaka is skilled in combat, having taught [[sword]] forms to [[Simon]]. He is capable of sharpening his bladed arms against one another like knives.}}
